scope: Showcase-specific examples only; no project style, view, palette, canvas or motion defaults.

accepted_generation.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Input1 is a MOTION AND LAYOUT GUIDE, not a visual style. Its eight skeletons are the exact chronological poses to follow. Input2 is the heroine's approved FACE AND HAIR identity. Render a beautiful finished pixel-art character into each of Input1's eight poses. This is not concept art: it is an actual connected eight-frame running cycle.
The guide colors identify limb ownership: LIME/GREEN is the near leg, PURPLE is the far leg; ORANGE is the near arm, BLUE is the far arm. Replace those artificial colors with costume art, but preserve the exact pelvis, knees, ankle, elbow and fist locations and the alternating near/far phases. In frames4,5,6 the near leg must clearly trail behind the pelvis to the LEFT, matching the green guide. DO NOT repeat the near-leg-forward pose in all frames. The near arm alternates back/front following the orange guide.
Character: same attractive adult futuristic woman from Input2, violet bob and small ponytail, violet eyes, cyan earpiece. Ivory cropped jacket with coral lining, navy fitted sci-fi trousers, white cyan knee guards, white navy coral high-top running shoes, dark fingerless gloves. Rich harmonious colors, no numeric cap. Keep face, chest and jacket front toward the same three-quarter RIGHT-facing view in all frames, never show her back. The same near shoulder and same visible cheek must stay visible.

Four columns by two rows, square cells, exactly EIGHT complete figures, aligned with the guide centers and scale. Preserve safe transparent margins on all sides of every cell. Gentle 2pixel body bounce matching the guide; no side flip, no separate character redesign between frames. Proper connected knees/elbows and natural closed gloved fists, two legs and two arms per frame, complete boots. In-place run, no ground, shadow or prop. Only transparent negative space. No guide lines, colored skeleton segments, text, labels or numbers in final art.
TRUE PIXEL ART on 160x160 logical cells: deliberate hard square pixel clusters, clean stepped contours, crisp flat shade blocks, attractive face. Not a smooth anime painting, no antialiasing or blur. The pose guide has priority for the body, the face reference has priority for identity.

native_pose_guide.note: Guide colors express body-part ownership, not final costume colors.

rejected_generation_attempts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Reference role: approved character design only. Make a new professional PIXEL-ART RUN CYCLE of this same attractive adult futuristic heroine. Preserve the violet bob/short ponytail, cyan earpiece, ivory cropped jacket with coral lining, navy fitted trousers, white cyan knee guards, fingerless gloves and ivory navy coral running shoes. Preserve her face and appealing proportions. No weapon.

The deliverable is exactly EIGHT chronological, connected game animation keyframes, FOUR columns by TWO rows, equal square cells. All 8 keep exactly the SAME fixed three-quarter side view facing RIGHT, with her FRONT jacket opening visible. The chest must NEVER switch to a back view. The camera is locked; no turning. The pelvis, collar and head maintain their identity and angle, with only a gentle two-pixel vertical running bounce. Identical scale and body anchor; whole body including hair, fingers and both shoes stays inside the central 75 percent of each cell. Actual transparent background. No grid lines, labels or floor.

Animate a physically connected in-place run. Distinguish NEAR leg from FAR leg by perspective and shading: near leg is in front, brightly lit with its white kneepad; far leg is behind, darker. They must maintain that identity through all 8 poses. Arms swing in opposite phase to corresponding legs; preserve complete natural closed gloved fists, elbows and shoulders. Distinct phases:
1 NEAR foot reaches forward/right and lands, FAR thigh reaches back/left and foot lifts behind. FAR arm forward/right, NEAR arm back/left.
2 NEAR foot under weight, knee bent forward, body slightly lower; FAR knee folds behind and begins to travel forward. Arms approach middle.
3 NEAR leg pushes backward/left, FAR knee lifts forward/right, both elbows pass through a relaxed middle position.
4 airborne: FAR shin extends forward/right, NEAR leg folds backward/left; NEAR arm forward/right, FAR arm back/left.
5 FAR foot reaches forward/right and lands, NEAR thigh back/left with folded foot. NEAR arm forward/right and FAR arm back/left.
6 FAR knee compresses under the body, NEAR knee folds behind then passes under pelvis. Arms approach middle.
7 FAR leg pushes backward/left, NEAR knee lifts forward/right. Arms cross the middle in continuous motion.
8 airborne: NEAR shin reaches forward/right ready for frame1, FAR leg folds backward/left; FAR arm forward/right, NEAR arm back/left.
The next frame after 8 is 1 with no jump in limb identity, angle, position or clothing. Do NOT repeat pose1 as pose5 with a sudden torso flip. Legs and arms must articulate at joints; do not make 8 unrelated running illustrations. Head faces right with the same visible cheek in every frame. Same near shoulder and same side of pouch always visible.

TRUE pixel-art medium on a 160x160 logical canvas per frame: clearly countable square pixels, hard clustered shapes, clean stair-step contours, intentional flat shade blocks, no smooth painted shading, no glow, no blur or antialiasing. Attractive face and thoughtfully shaped hands and boots. Rich color harmony without a numeric color cap. Generous transparent padding: no pose or limb ever crosses its own cell. Only one complete figure in each cell. No other objects, writing, logos or watermarks.
rejected_generation_attempts.reason: Torso consistency improved but near-leg phase remained repeated; not published.

rejected_generation_attempts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Use the supplied image ONLY to preserve this exact adult futuristic heroine's face, violet short ponytail hair, white/coral cropped jacket, navy trousers, white cyan kneepads and ivory navy coral shoes. Change her pose completely.

Create ONE isolated complete pixel-art figure facing RIGHT in the same three-quarter side projection, at the landing pose of the OPPOSITE half of a running stride:
The NEAR leg (the side with visible bright white cyan kneepad and orange hip pouch) stretches BACK toward the LEFT, upper thigh slanting down-left and knee bent, heel high behind her. The FAR leg stretches FORWARD toward the RIGHT and lands heel first. The far thigh must be clearly visible going forward beneath the jacket while the near thigh clearly goes backward. At the hips the near leg overlays the far leg. This is absolutely not the reference pose, which has the near leg forward.
The NEAR arm swings FORWARD, elbow in front of the ribs, forearm up-right, closed gloved fist at chest level. The FAR arm swings BACK to the left, elbow behind her back and fist down-left.
Keep her front jacket opening and the SAME visible cheek; do NOT turn her torso to show her back. Natural hips, elbows, knees and ankles. Athletic forward lean, no floating detached hands, no merged limbs.
True beautifully designed pixel art at 160x160 logical sprite scale with hard pixel clusters, no smooth painting or blur. Attractive face, readable layered costume. Complete body and every shoe/finger with 15% transparent padding on every edge. Just ONE pose and one character, centered on actual transparent background. No ground, floor, shadow, text or labels.
rejected_generation_attempts.reason: Single-pose attempt retained the old forward near leg rather than following the requested reversal; not published.

rejected_generation_attempts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
The input is ONLY a face and hairstyle reference. Keep this same attractive adult heroine's violet eyes, purple bob and small short ponytail, cyan earpiece, and facial charm. Construct a NEW complete running animation body; do not copy any old full-body pose.

Create a polished TRUE PIXEL ART 8-frame IN-PLACE RUN CYCLE, FOUR equal square columns by TWO equal square rows, left-to-right then top-to-bottom chronology. Camera locked to a near-side view facing RIGHT, with the same near shoulder and front jacket opening always visible. Ivory cropped technical jacket with coral lining, navy undersuit and trousers, cyan kneepads, ivory navy coral high-top shoes, dark fingerless gloves. Near leg has bright white kneepad and cyan stripe; far leg is darker and visually behind the near leg. Every frame must show two properly attached legs and two properly attached arms, natural knees/elbows/fists, constant head size. 160x160 logical pixels per frame; clean hard pixel clusters, stepped outlines, no airbrush or blur.

CRITICAL motion requirement: the NEAR leg MUST MOVE BACK in the second half. Do not make all 8 poses with near leg forward. A coherent gait is more important than decorative detail.
Frame1 NEAR leg straight forward-right heel landing, FAR leg extended back-left. NEAR arm back-left; FAR arm forward-right.
Frame2 NEAR knee bent under weight, FAR foot curling high behind. Arms moving toward middle.
Frame3 NEAR leg straight back-left pushing off the ground, FAR knee raised up and forward-right. NEAR arm now forward-right, FAR arm back-left.
Frame4 NEAR leg folded back-left heel high, FAR lower leg extending forward-right while airborne.
Frame5 FAR leg straight forward-right heel landing; NEAR leg extended BACK-LEFT with bright kneepad visibly to the LEFT of the hips. NEAR arm forward-right; FAR arm back-left.
Frame6 FAR knee bent under weight; NEAR thigh behind and NEAR heel curling high behind-left. Arms moving toward middle.
Frame7 FAR leg straight back-left pushing off; NEAR knee raised forward-right. FAR arm forward-right; NEAR arm back-left.
Frame8 FAR leg folded back-left heel high; NEAR lower leg extending forward-right ready for frame1. Arms return smoothly to frame1.
In frames3-6 the white near kneepad must be back/left of the pelvis or under it, never continuously held forward. The torso MUST NOT turn or change side when the legs exchange. The arm near the viewer must also swing from back to front across the cycle, not remain stuck behind.

Head and hips gently bob only 2 logical pixels, same scale and central root. Both contact feet land at the same baseline. Keep every entire figure much smaller than its cell: 15% actual empty transparent margin in every direction, no hair or shoes near cell boundaries, no overlapping rows. No scenery, shadows, ground, text, labels, grid, weapon or extra objects. Genuine transparent background. Rich harmonious colors, no numeric palette cap.
rejected_generation_attempts.reason: A face-only reference still produced repeated leg ownership; not published.

native_finishing: Native nearest-neighbor draft registration and binary-alpha corrections; consistent face/earpiece/hair on an editable layer; coral near-kneepad marker and targeted glove/knuckle contours; separate shoulder/arm occlusion finishing layer. No crossfades, blur, optical flow, or duplicate-pose whole-body shifts.
